samuddhārasya tatprakārasya taduttaracaryāyā videhamuktapariśiṣṭatadrūpasya ca
caturbhiḥ kiṃvṛttaiḥ kramātpraśnaḥ
prāvṛṣa oghena pūreṇa upanītaṃ kiṃciddūraṃ pravāhitam
tyāgaḥ saṃśrayo vā nopādeyo nāpekṣaṇīyo viśeṣābhāvāt

munirmananaśīlo bhagavān sūryo hṛdgataṃ hṛdi
praviṣṭaṃ taṃ munināyakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya kāryaṃ tatpaurvāparyaṃ ca
dṛṣṭvā vindhyabhūdharakośagataṃ gatasaṃvidaṃ mṛtaprāyaṃ munikalevaraṃ
dadarśeti vyavahitenānvayaḥ
tato raviḥ kiṃ cakāra tadāha - ṛṣeriti

sūryahṛtpraviṣṭā muneḥ
saṃvitkiṃ cakāra tadāha - vītahavyeti

sa munirbhānunā hṛdyeva bahumānapūrvakamabhyanujñātaḥ san
svakāryārthaṃ prasthitaṃ piṅgalasya ākāraṃ śarīraṃ viveśa

tatpakṣe kuñjaiḥ
kuñjarairiva ca sundaramiti yojyam

nakhairniṣkṛṣṭaṃ khātaṃ bhūtalaṃ yena
tathāvidhaḥ piṅgalaḥ

mūrtaḥ prāptamūrtirvītahavyaśca nabhaścarapiṅgalaśca
mithaḥ anyonyaṃ praṇematuḥ
